levels.name: First delivery
levels.tip: Tap left or right of your rider to change lanes. Grab a 📦, then ride through a green DROP zone.

levels.name: Morning rush
levels.tip: More autos and cars on the road. Keep your parcels safe.

levels.name: Pothole street
levels.tip: Swipe up (or press ⬆) to jump over potholes and speed breakers.

levels.name: Cow crossing
levels.tip: Cows can't be jumped. Change lanes!

levels.name: Monsoon evening
levels.tip: Rain slows your lane changes. Move early.

levels.name: Midnight cravings
levels.tip: Night shift. The fastest run in Koramangala.

endless.name: Endless
endless.tip: How far can you go? It never stops getting faster.
